name: reset clears everything
setup: hold rst_n low for 3 clocks, release
expect: done=0, active=0, overflow=0, count reads 0

name: reset clears a sticky overflow
setup: run the overflow window to completion, then reset
expect: overflow=0 after reset

name: window select 0 selects 256 cycles
setup: uio[2:1]=0, arm A, ro_idx=0, pulse start
expect: done rises within 264 clocks; count is nonzero

name: window select 1 selects 512 cycles
setup: uio[2:1]=1, arm A, ro_idx=0, pulse start
expect: done rises within 520 clocks; count is nonzero

name: window select 2 selects 2048 cycles
setup: uio[2:1]=2, arm A, ro_idx=0, pulse start
expect: done rises within 2056 clocks; count is nonzero

name: window select 3 selects 16384 cycles
setup: uio[2:1]=3, arm A, ro_idx=0, pulse start
expect: done rises within 16392 clocks; count is nonzero

name: active is high only while the window is open
setup: uio[2:1]=0, pulse start, sample uio[5] every clock
expect: active high for 256 clocks then low; done rises as active falls

name: done and active tell a fresh result from a stale one
setup: after reset, before any start
expect: done=0 and active=0, which no completed run can show

name: double the window, double the count
setup: same ring, window 256 then window 512

name: eight times the window, eight times the count
setup: same ring, window 256 then window 2048

name: the overflow window sets the sticky flag
setup: uio[2:1]=3, any ring, pulse start
expect: overflow=1 on every die and every corner

name: the sticky flag survives the next measurement
setup: run the overflow window, then a safe window, without reset
expect: overflow stays 1

name: a safe window never sets it
setup: reset, then every safe window on every oscillator
expect: overflow stays 0

name: both bytes reassemble the count
setup: after done, read ui[6]=0 then ui[6]=1
expect: high<<8 | low equals the count, and repeats stably

name: the count does not move between the two byte reads
setup: read low, wait 100 clocks, read low again
expect: identical

name: the protocol byte reads back
expect: uo_out = 2

name: the build byte reads back
expect: uo_out = 0x1A

name: the version select does not disturb a stored count
setup: after done, set uio[3]=1, read, clear uio[3], read the count
expect: count unchanged

name: every oscillator in arm A, automated answers
setup: arm=0, ro_idx 0..15, window 512
expect: 16 distinct done pulses, every count in range

name: every oscillator in arm B, hardened answers
setup: arm=1, ro_idx 0..15, window 512
expect: 16 distinct done pulses, every count in range

name: every oscillator in arm C, constrained answers
setup: arm=2, ro_idx 0..15, window 512
expect: 16 distinct done pulses, every count in range
